text:
Sam: Heads up — found an AWS IAM ARN and a partial access token in a staging ConfigMap for app-backend. Not full keys but looks like a long-lived role reference. Tagging sec + platform. :rotating_light:
ops-bot: Detector: configmap-credential-scan matched /namespaces/staging/configmaps/app-backend-config at 2024-06-03T02:13:45Z. Severity: medium. Logs archived to s3://redwood-incident-queue/1728004321/ (auto).
Maria: Treat as exposed creds. We'll do containment + audit + rotation. First: confirm blast radius (which secrets reference this role) and whether any active tokens were minted. @Jordan can you check Vault AWS auth bindings?
Jordan: Quick check: token fragment doesn't match any active session I can find, but there's a Vault role "app-backend-staging" mapped to that IAM role. Apps authenticate via Vault AWS auth and then pull several secrets (DB creds, API keys) that are sealed-secrets-wrapped. Staging uses KMS CMK alias "alias/redwood/kms-staging" for sealed-secrets.
Lee: Proposed plan: 1) Temporarily revoke the Vault role mapping (disable role) 2) Create a new CMK in staging (alias/redwood/kms-staging-rot1) 3) Re-encrypt sealed-secrets with new CMK + redeploy 4) Rotate any long-lived service tokens. Can schedule a 60m maintenance window tonight at 23:00 UTC for this?
Sam: Devs confirm no deployments planned tonight. Window ok if we keep it tight.
Maria: Also need Vault and KMS audit logs for the past 7 days to check for exfil. @ops-bot can you pull KMS and Vault audit log slices into an incident bucket and share path?
ops-bot: Request queued. Will export: s3://redwood-incident-logs/staging/1728004321/audit-logs.tar.gz — ETA ~15m.
Jordan: I'll prepare a short runbook/checklist for the window:
```
- disable Vault role: vault write auth/aws/role/app-backend-staging token_ttl=0
- create CMK and alias in staging
- re-encrypt artifacts: aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://secret.enc --destination-key-id alias/redwood/kms-staging-rot1
- update sealed-secrets and kubectl apply
- restart one canary pod and validate
- re-enable Vault role
- rotate any service tokens discovered
```
Maria: Note — sealed-secrets uses a transit key wrapping the payload; if the KMS-backed envelope changes we must rewrap transit key material or re-issue sealed secrets. Jordan, include that in the checklist. Also ensure audit logging for Vault's sys/audit is enabled and we snapshot it before changes.
Lee: I'll run the canary re-encrypt first (single secret, single pod) then escalate. I'll own execution. Maria owns security sign-off, Jordan owns validation.
ops-bot: Audit dump completed: s3://redwood-incident-logs/staging/1728004321/audit-logs.tar.gz (contains kms-events.json.gz, vault-audit.json.gz).
Sam: Thanks. Owners set: @Lee exec, @Maria security sign-off, @Jordan validation. After the window we'll do short postmortem + CVE check for any related libs. Keep this thread for status updates during the window.
Maria: Quick follow-ups before window: 1) list of secrets referencing the role (Jordan) 2) list of long-lived tokens (Jordan) 3) approval of maintenance window (Sam) — please post asap.
Jordan: Posting lists now (short): secrets: db/staging/postgres, api/staging/stripe, smtp/staging. Long-lived tokens: none found in active token list but will rotate any leftover service tokens just in case.
Sam: Copy that. Standby for 23:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
